Sam (FinOps): Heads-up—received invoice INV-0423 for Mar billing. Looks like a ~$12k overage on a reserved commit for customer Skylark. Can someone sync on the line items?
Priya Shah: Ugh. Which commit/period? I can pull the usage CSV.
Sam (FinOps): Commit name skylark-prod-4, period 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-31. Invoice line 14 shows "overage tokens" 42M @ $0.00028/token = $11,760.
Liam O'Connor: BillingBot posted the meter a few hours ago — I can cross-check logs. Might be a burst event on 2026-03-12.
BillingBot: meter_report: commit=skylark-prod-4 period=2026-03-01..2026-03-31 peak_burst=3h total_tokens=182M reserved_allowance=140M overage=42M
Marco (Acct Manager): Skylark had a scheduled migration on the 12th, was told they'd be on burst. Do we have a signed burst policy for them?
Priya Shah: I checked the contract: reserved commit 1.2M tokens/day typical; burst allowed up to 4h/day at 2x rate, but need explicit approval for sustained >4h. No written approval for the 12th.
Elena (Revenue): If the spike was due to a platform incident (our side), we should consider SLA credit instead of charging. Any error reports for that timeframe?
Liam O'Connor: Runtime logs: on 2026-03-12 03:10 -> 06:50 UTC we had higher 503s for region-us-west-2; but that was internal throttling. I pulled the trace id list.
Sam (FinOps): So options: 1) charge overage as-is, 2) apply partial credit if we find platform-induced reruns, 3) escalate to legal for contract interpretation. Preference?
Priya Shah: Requesting usage breakdown by route (inference vs embeddings). If the spike is embeddings-heavy (cheap), we could adjust pricing model.
Marco (Acct Manager): I'll loop in the customer — we should offer a one-time bill adjustment while we investigate. Keeps them happy.
Elena (Revenue): Agreed on provisional adjustment. Sam—please prep an estimate for a provisional credit (50% of overage) and a note that final invoice pending recon. Priya/Liam—can you deliver the detailed CSV and traces by EOD PST?
Sam (FinOps): On it. I'll draft the credit note and mark invoice INV-0423 as disputed in the billing system: dispute#D-1793456789.
BillingBot: invoice_status: INV-0423 -> disputed (dispute_id=D-1793456789)
Priya Shah: CSV export queued: /secure-bucket/skylark/usage/2026-03-detailed.csv (shared with Marco + Sam).
Liam O'Connor: Sending relevant traces and the 503 summary to Sam and Elena.
Marco (Acct Manager): I'll notify the customer that we've opened a dispute and will provisionally reduce the bill by $5,880 pending final reconciliation. I'll include the migration note.
Sam (FinOps): Thanks — will post final reconciliation steps once we confirm whether burst was customer-driven or platform-caused. :thumbsup:
Elena (Revenue): Keep me posted. If this becomes a pattern we need to revisit burst policy language in SOWs.
Sam (FinOps): Will do. TL;DR: invoice INV-0423 disputed, provisional 50% credit applied, action items assigned (Priya/Liam) for detailed recon.
Marco (Acct Manager): Cool. I'll set a calendar reminder for the follow-up next Tue.
Priya Shah: EOD update incoming.
Liam O'Connor: Done — traces shared.
Sam (FinOps): Closing loop later today. Thanks team.
